_doc: What the V3 Blender export must contain so the website can drive it (rotate, assemble, exploded view, airflow, reset, scroll camera) without hard-coding anything per model. Checked by v3/tools/validate-glb.mjs; the emblem silhouette is checked separately by v3/tools/emblem_fit.py.

space.front: +Z: the emblem faces the viewer on +Z, as on the logo
space.restPose: assembled: every part at its final position in the logo layout
space.logoFrame: Front view in the official PNG frame: 1 PNG pixel = 1 mm (0.001 m), origin at the PNG top-left corner, x right, y up (so the emblem lies at y < 0). emblem_fit.py --register contract checks against it without any fitting.

extras._doc: Blender custom property 'libalstal' on each part object, exported with export_extras=True. Origins are the mechanical pivots.

optional.explode: [x, y, z] metres: where the part sits in the exploded view, relative to its rest position
optional.axis: [x, y, z] unit vector: hinge axis or slide direction, in the parent's space
optional.limits: [min, max] radians or metres along axis

materials._doc: Names the site maps to its own real-time materials; texture images optional (PBR, ≤ 2048 px, KTX2 later).

animations.assemble: optional clip, exploded → assembled over ≤ 4 s; the site can also build it from extras.explode with GSAP

airflow._doc: Next to the GLB. Centrelines in the same space (metres, +Y up): { note, paths: { name: [[x,y,z], ...] } }. Must state it is illustrative, not CFD.
